title: Things to Do (for the weekend of September 26th)
description:
Looking for something to do in Los Angeles? From bilingual storytelling and scenic harbor tours to a lively cultural festival and a firehouse cook-off, here’s what’s happening near you.

📚 LOS ANGELES LIBROS FESTIVAL
Saturday, September 26 | 10:00 AM-4:00 PM
Celebrate books, literacy and community at the Los Angeles Public Library’s free bilingual festival at Central Library. Enjoy Spanish-language and bilingual storytelling, musical performances, authors, workshops and books for the whole family. Registration is available through Eventbrite.
🌐 LAPL.org/libros

🛥️ FREE HARBOR BOAT TOURS
Saturday, September 26 | 11:00 AM–2:00 PM
Explore the Port of Los Angeles during a free, 50-minute narrated harbor tour departing every 30 minutes from Downtown Harbor in San Pedro. Boarding is first-come, first-served, and the line will close at 1:00 PM or when capacity is reached.
🌐 PortOfLosAngeles.org

🪅 LATINO CARNAVAL 2026
Saturday, September 26 | 11:00 AM–7:00 PM
Celebrate Latino culture at the free 2nd Annual Latino Carnaval at The Reef in South Los Angeles. The festival features live music across two stages, carnival rides and games, food, drinks and more than 200 vendors. Free advance RSVP is required.
🌐 Instagram: @CurrenDPriceJr

🚒 SALUTE TO FIREFIGHTERS FESTIVAL
Saturday, September 26 | 9:00 AM–4:00 PM
Celebrate Los Angeles firefighters at Warner Center Park in Woodland Hills. More than 15 firehouses and fire-service partners will compete in a cook-off. The free festival also features live music, a classic car show, a beer garden, firefighting demonstrations and family activities. Tasting passes are sold separately, with proceeds benefiting the Widows, Orphans & Disabled Firefighter’s Fund.
🌐 WODFF.org
